title.zh: Balancer Proposes Shutting Down and Returning Its $9 Million Treasury to BAL Holders
title.en: Balancer Proposes Shutting Down and Returning Its $9 Million Treasury to BAL Holders

current_state.zh: Balancer has proposed winding down the protocol, moving pools to withdrawals-only on Oct. 30 and letting BAL holders burn tokens for a pro-rata share of its $9 million treasury starting May 2027.
current_state.en: Balancer has proposed winding down the protocol, moving pools to withdrawals-only on Oct. 30 and letting BAL holders burn tokens for a pro-rata share of its $9 million treasury starting May 2027.
